note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; the document (generic lines and blocks), its reference, the supplied region, exhibits and order are as supplied and carry no legal assessment (no authenticity, admissibility, weight or ruling).
